description: This file defines the PersistentStateAttributeMapper class, which maps persistent state attributes to factory instances within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for generating factories based on attribute parameters, with logic for handling generic types and configuration settings.

classes.name: PersistentStateAttributeMapper
classes.description: A class that maps PersistentState attributes to factory functions used to create persistent state instances.

classes.name: PersistentStateConfiguration
classes.description: A private nested class implementing IPersistentStateConfiguration, holding configuration data such as state and storage names.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory function that produces persistent state objects based on method parameters and attribute data.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Invokes the generic create method on the IPersistentStateFactory to instantiate persistent state objects.
